meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 就能用 WhatsApp:用手机扫码或输入配对码关联一个号码,之后你可以在这个号码的私聊里和它对话;用自己的个人号码时,它只理会你发的消息,别人发的都会被忽略。
howto.when: 当你要求把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp、添加 WhatsApp 频道,或提到要扫码/配对码关联设备时触发。它会先确认使用专用还是个人号码,再做连接。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp
say.note: 开始安装 WhatsApp 频道,先确认号码类型。

say.text: 用我的个人号码接入 WhatsApp
say.note: 会先展示账号风险提示,需要你确认继续。
终端生成 8 位码,在手机上输入完成配对。

howto.what_en: Adds WhatsApp support to NanoClaw: link a number with QR or pairing code, then chat with the agent in that number's DMs. On a personal number it only reads your own messages; group behavior follows the configured name/mention rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or set up WhatsApp for NanoClaw, or mention linking a device via QR or pairing code. It first confirms whether you'll use a dedicated or personal number, then continues with linking.

say_en.note: Starts the install and asks which number to use.
Shows the account-risk warning and asks for confirmation.
Shows an 8-character code to enter in WhatsApp.
